COMMUNAL_HEARTH.Name: COMMUNAL_HEARTH
COMMUNAL_HEARTH.NAME: Communal Hearth
COMMUNAL_HEARTH.SR: Increases Villager gather rate and converts enemy units.
COMMUNAL_HEARTH.LR: A public hearth assembled by Hestia. Increases nearby Villager gather rate and converts enemy units.

TOWN_CENTER.Name: TOWN_CENTER
TOWN_CENTER.NAME: Town Center
TOWN_CENTER.LR: Trains Villagers, advances through the Ages, is a drop site for all resources, and supports population. Town Centers are built over Settlements.

VILLAGE_CENTER.Name: VILLAGE_CENTER
VILLAGE_CENTER.NAME: Village Center
VILLAGE_CENTER.LR: Trains Villagers and is a drop site for all resources. Village Centers can be built anywhere on the map.

SETTLEMENT.Name: SETTLEMENT
SETTLEMENT.NAME: Settlement
SETTLEMENT.SR: Build a Town Center here to claim this Settlement.
SETTLEMENT.LR: An abandoned or unclaimed village. Build a Town Center on top of a Settlement to claim it.

WOODEN_WALL.Name: WOODEN_WALL
WOODEN_WALL.NAME: Wooden Wall
WOODEN_WALL.LR: Protects towns. Shift-click to place wall sections, and then click to place the wall.

HOUSE.Name: HOUSE
HOUSE.NAME: House
HOUSE.LR: Supports 10 population. After you reach the House build limit, you must construct Town Centers to support additional population.

FARM.Name: FARM
FARM.NAME: Farm
FARM.LR: Farms provide unlimited Food, but are slower than hunting or herding.

DOCK.Name: DOCK
DOCK.NAME: Dock
DOCK.LR: Constructs ships and naval myth units, and serves as a drop site for fish and other food. Must be built near water.

GRANARY.Name: GRANARY
GRANARY.NAME: Granary
GRANARY.LR: A drop site where Villagers deposit Food that they have gathered.

TEMPLE.Name: TEMPLE
TEMPLE.NAME: Temple
TEMPLE.SR: Provides access to mythical units and technologies.
TEMPLE.LR: Trains powerful myth units and provides mythological improvements granted by the gods.

TEMPLE_OF_DEMETER.Name: TEMPLE_OF_DEMETER
TEMPLE_OF_DEMETER.NAME: Temple of Demeter
TEMPLE_OF_DEMETER.SR: Provides access to mythical units and technologies.
TEMPLE_OF_DEMETER.LR: Temple built in honor of the goddess Demeter. Trains powerful myth units and provides mythological improvements.

SENTRY_TOWER.Name: SENTRY_TOWER
SENTRY_TOWER.NAME: Sentry Tower
SENTRY_TOWER.LR: Provides line of sight around your town and lets units garrison inside. Upgrade them to fire upon enemies.

ARMORY.Name: ARMORY
ARMORY.NAME: Armory
ARMORY.LR: Allows you to improve the weapons and armor of infantry, ranged soldiers, cavalry, and ships.

MARKET.Name: MARKET
MARKET.NAME: Market
MARKET.LR: You can train Caravans and trade resources at your Market.

TITAN_GATE.Name: TITAN_GATE
TITAN_GATE.NAME: Titan Gate
TITAN_GATE.LR: Villagers or Norse infantry tasked on the Titan Gate will dig out a Titan.

WONDER.Name: WONDER
WONDER.NAME: Wonder
WONDER.LR: Constructing a Wonder advances you to the Wonder Age, where the Gods will reward you with great world ending power.

TENT.Name: TENT
TENT.NAME: Tent
TENT.LR: A temporary shelter that supports 10 population. Tents cannot be rebuilt if lost.

STOREHOUSE.Name: STOREHOUSE
STOREHOUSE.NAME: Storehouse
STOREHOUSE.LR: A drop site where Villagers deposit Wood and Gold that they have gathered.

MILITARY_ACADEMY.Name: MILITARY_ACADEMY
MILITARY_ACADEMY.NAME: Military Academy
MILITARY_ACADEMY.LR: Greek Military Academies train and upgrade infantry and counter-infantry units.

STABLE.Name: STABLE
STABLE.NAME: Stable
STABLE.LR: Greek Stables train and upgrade cavalry and counter-cavalry units.

ARCHERY_RANGE.Name: ARCHERY_RANGE
ARCHERY_RANGE.NAME: Archery Range
ARCHERY_RANGE.LR: Greek Archery Ranges train and upgrade ranged soldier and counter-ranged soldier units.

FORTRESS.Name: FORTRESS
FORTRESS.NAME: Fortress
FORTRESS.SR: Fortification. Trains siege, heroes and powerful unique units.
FORTRESS.LR: Greek Fortresses fire arrows and garrison units. They also train siege weapons, heroes, and powerful unique units.

OBELISK.Name: OBELISK
OBELISK.NAME: Obelisk
OBELISK.LR: Summoned by Egyptian Priests to aid in scouting and provide line of sight.

MONUMENT_TO_VILLAGERS.Name: MONUMENT_TO_VILLAGERS
MONUMENT_TO_VILLAGERS.NAME: Monument to Villagers
MONUMENT_TO_VILLAGERS.LR: A small Monument. Monuments generate Favor. You must build smaller Monuments before you can build the larger ones.

MONUMENT_TO_SOLDIERS.Name: MONUMENT_TO_SOLDIERS
MONUMENT_TO_SOLDIERS.NAME: Monument to Soldiers
MONUMENT_TO_SOLDIERS.LR: A moderate Monument. Monuments generate Favor. You must build smaller Monuments before you can build the larger ones.

MONUMENT_TO_PRIESTS.Name: MONUMENT_TO_PRIESTS
MONUMENT_TO_PRIESTS.NAME: Monument to Priests
MONUMENT_TO_PRIESTS.LR: A large Monument. Monuments generate Favor. You must build smaller Monuments before you can build the larger ones.

MONUMENT_TO_PHARAOHS.Name: MONUMENT_TO_PHARAOHS
MONUMENT_TO_PHARAOHS.NAME: Monument to Pharaohs
MONUMENT_TO_PHARAOHS.LR: A very large Monument. Monuments generate Favor. You must build smaller Monuments before you can build the larger ones.

MONUMENT_TO_GODS.Name: MONUMENT_TO_GODS
MONUMENT_TO_GODS.NAME: Monument to Gods
MONUMENT_TO_GODS.LR: The greatest Monument of them all. Monuments generate Favor.

MINING_CAMP.Name: MINING_CAMP
MINING_CAMP.NAME: Mining Camp
MINING_CAMP.LR: A drop site where Villagers deposit Gold that they have gathered.

LUMBER_CAMP.Name: LUMBER_CAMP
LUMBER_CAMP.NAME: Lumber Camp
LUMBER_CAMP.LR: A drop site where Villagers deposit Wood that they have gathered.

BARRACKS.Name: BARRACKS
BARRACKS.NAME: Barracks
BARRACKS.LR: Egyptian Barracks train Spearmen, Axemen and Slingers.

MIGDOL_STRONGHOLD.Name: MIGDOL_STRONGHOLD
MIGDOL_STRONGHOLD.NAME: Migdol Stronghold
MIGDOL_STRONGHOLD.SR: Fortification. Trains and upgrades mounted units.
MIGDOL_STRONGHOLD.LR: Egyptian Migdol Strongholds fire arrows and garrison units. They also train and upgrade powerful mounted units.

SIEGE_WORKS.Name: SIEGE_WORKS
SIEGE_WORKS.NAME: Siege Works
SIEGE_WORKS.SR: Military building. Builds and upgrades siege weapons.
SIEGE_WORKS.LR: Egyptian Siege Works construct and upgrade powerful siege weapons.

LIGHTHOUSE.Name: LIGHTHOUSE
LIGHTHOUSE.NAME: Lighthouse
LIGHTHOUSE.LR: Provides gigantic line of sight, but cannot attack.

DWARVEN_ARMORY.Name: DWARVEN_ARMORY
DWARVEN_ARMORY.NAME: Dwarven Armory
DWARVEN_ARMORY.LR: Thor's special Armory improves the weapons and armor of infantry, cavalry, and ships. The Dwarven Armory also spawns a free Dwarf for each upgrade that it researches, and researches faster in later ages.

GREAT_HALL.Name: GREAT_HALL
GREAT_HALL.NAME: Great Hall
GREAT_HALL.SR: Military building. Trains heroes and cavalry.
GREAT_HALL.LR: Norse Great Halls train and upgrade heroes and cavalry.

LONGHOUSE.Name: LONGHOUSE
LONGHOUSE.NAME: Longhouse
LONGHOUSE.LR: Norse Longhouses train and upgrade basic infantry units.

HILL_FORT.Name: HILL_FORT
HILL_FORT.NAME: Hill Fort
HILL_FORT.SR: Military building. Trains elite units and siege units.
HILL_FORT.LR: Norse Hill Forts fire arrows and garrison units. They also train elite units and siege weapons.

MANOR.Name: MANOR
MANOR.NAME: Manor
MANOR.LR: Supports 20 population. After you reach the Manor build limit, you must construct Town Centers to support additional population.

ECONOMIC_GUILD.Name: ECONOMIC_GUILD
ECONOMIC_GUILD.NAME: Economic Guild
ECONOMIC_GUILD.LR: Economic Guilds are used to research all Atlantean economic improvements.

SKY_PASSAGE.Name: SKY_PASSAGE
SKY_PASSAGE.NAME: Sky Passage
SKY_PASSAGE.LR: Units garrisoned inside can instantly travel from one Sky Passage to another. This can be done periodically.

MILITARY_BARRACKS.Name: MILITARY_BARRACKS
MILITARY_BARRACKS.NAME: Military Barracks
MILITARY_BARRACKS.LR: Atlantean Military Barracks train Murmillones, Contarii, and Arci.

COUNTER_BARRACKS.Name: COUNTER_BARRACKS
COUNTER_BARRACKS.NAME: Counter Barracks
COUNTER_BARRACKS.LR: Atlantean Counter Barracks train counter-cavalry, counter-ranged soldier, and counter-infantry units.

PALACE.Name: PALACE
PALACE.NAME: Palace
PALACE.SR: Fortification. Trains elite units and siege weapons.
PALACE.LR: Atlantean Palaces fire arrows and garrison units. They also train and upgrade elite units and siege weapons.

MIRROR_TOWER.Name: MIRROR_TOWER
MIRROR_TOWER.NAME: Mirror Tower
MIRROR_TOWER.LR: Tower that fires a focused ray of sunlight.

LURE.Name: LURE
LURE.NAME: Lure
LURE.SR: Food drop site. Temporarily attracts wild animals.
LURE.LR: Food drop site. Mysterious glyphs attract all nearby wild animals, for a time.

UNDERWORLD_PASSAGE.Name: UNDERWORLD_PASSAGE
UNDERWORLD_PASSAGE.NAME: Underworld Passage
UNDERWORLD_PASSAGE.SR: Tunnel. Allows units to travel instantly to the other side.
UNDERWORLD_PASSAGE.LR: Tunnel that allows units to travel instantly to the other side.

PLENTY_VAULT.Name: PLENTY_VAULT
PLENTY_VAULT.NAME: Plenty Vault
PLENTY_VAULT.LR: Vault of the gods that generates unlimited wealth for whomever captures and controls it.

CITADEL_CENTER.Name: CITADEL_CENTER
CITADEL_CENTER.NAME: Citadel Center
CITADEL_CENTER.LR: A heavily fortified Town Center which trains units and researches technologies faster.

HEALING_SPRING.Name: HEALING_SPRING
HEALING_SPRING.NAME: Healing Spring
HEALING_SPRING.LR: Heals units friendly to whomever controls it.

ASGARDIAN_HILL_FORT.Name: ASGARDIAN_HILL_FORT
ASGARDIAN_HILL_FORT.NAME: Asgardian Hill Fort
ASGARDIAN_HILL_FORT.SR: Ullr's fortification. Trains elite units and siege units.
ASGARDIAN_HILL_FORT.LR: Hill Fort summoned by Ullr to defend the realm of men. Garrisons units, and trains elite units and siege weapons.

HESPERIDES_TREE.Name: HESPERIDES_TREE
HESPERIDES_TREE.NAME: Hesperides Tree
HESPERIDES_TREE.LR: Trains Dryads for whomever captures and controls it. You can train 5 Dryads per Hesperides Tree.

TARTARIAN_GATE.Name: TARTARIAN_GATE
TARTARIAN_GATE.NAME: Tartarian Gate
TARTARIAN_GATE.LR: Until destroyed, this gate will continually spawn creatures hostile to all.

NAVAL_SHIPYARD.Name: NAVAL_SHIPYARD
NAVAL_SHIPYARD.NAME: Naval Shipyard
NAVAL_SHIPYARD.LR: Large cities use shipyards to mass-produce warships.

DWARVEN_FORGE.Name: DWARVEN_FORGE
DWARVEN_FORGE.NAME: Dwarven Forge
DWARVEN_FORGE.LR: Allows you to improve the weapons and armor of your soldiers and heroes.

TEMPLE_OVERGROWN.Name: TEMPLE_OVERGROWN
TEMPLE_OVERGROWN.NAME: Overgrown Temple
TEMPLE_OVERGROWN.LR: A temple to the ancient Titans, abandoned for many years.

TEMPLE_KRONOS.Name: TEMPLE_KRONOS
TEMPLE_KRONOS.NAME: Temple of Kronos
TEMPLE_KRONOS.LR: A special Temple of Kronos that cannot be time shifted or deleted. Garrison Relics inside to gain blessings from the gods.

TEMPLE_OF_THE_GODS.Name: TEMPLE_OF_THE_GODS
TEMPLE_OF_THE_GODS.NAME: Temple
TEMPLE_OF_THE_GODS.LR: A massive temple constructed at great expense.

STATUE_LIGHTNING.Name: STATUE_LIGHTNING
STATUE_LIGHTNING.NAME: Statue of Lightning
STATUE_LIGHTNING.LR: A work of art that fires lightning bolts!

ODINS_TOWER.Name: ODINS_TOWER
ODINS_TOWER.NAME: Odin's Tower
ODINS_TOWER.LR: Odin's stronghold in Midgard, and the center of his power.

SILO.Name: SILO
SILO.NAME: Silo
SILO.LR: A drop site where Villagers deposit Food, Wood, or Gold they have gathered.

MACHINE_WORKSHOP.Name: MACHINE_WORKSHOP
MACHINE_WORKSHOP.NAME: Machine Workshop
MACHINE_WORKSHOP.SR: Trains archers and siege weapons. Upgradeable with a Tower or Training Yard.
MACHINE_WORKSHOP.LR: Trains advanced Chinese ranged soldiers and siege weapons. Can be upgraded with a Tower for defense or a Training Yard to speed production.

MILITARY_CAMP.Name: MILITARY_CAMP
MILITARY_CAMP.NAME: Military Camp
MILITARY_CAMP.SR: Trains foot soldiers. Upgradeable with a Tower or Training Yard.
MILITARY_CAMP.LR: Trains Chinese foot soldiers. Can be upgraded with a Tower for defense or a Training Yard to speed production.

IMPERIAL_ACADEMY.Name: IMPERIAL_ACADEMY
IMPERIAL_ACADEMY.NAME: Imperial Academy
IMPERIAL_ACADEMY.LR: Building of higher learning that produces heroes and researches unique Chinese upgrades.

BAOLEI.Name: BAOLEI
BAOLEI.NAME: Baolei
BAOLEI.LR: Chinese Baoleis fire arrows and garrison units. They also train Chinese elite cavalry with powerful abilities.

FARM_SHENNONG.Name: FARM_SHENNONG
FARM_SHENNONG.NAME: Shennong's Farm
FARM_SHENNONG.LR: A farm blessed by Shennong. Is gathered faster and heals nearby villagers.

EARTH_WALL.Name: EARTH_WALL
EARTH_WALL.NAME: Earth Wall
EARTH_WALL.SR: Wall raised by Houtu that lets allies pass.
EARTH_WALL.LR: An earthen wall raised by Houtu. Allies can pass through, but enemies cannot. Starts with low hitpoints when summoned but quickly gets stronger.

THE_PEACH_BLOSSOM_SPRING.Name: THE_PEACH_BLOSSOM_SPRING
THE_PEACH_BLOSSOM_SPRING.NAME: Peach Blossom Spring
THE_PEACH_BLOSSOM_SPRING.LR: Can be harvested by villagers. Its resources are gathered very quickly, but the stockpile stops growing if a villager gathers from it.

TRADING_POST.Name: TRADING_POST
TRADING_POST.NAME: Trading Post
TRADING_POST.SR: Trade hub. Provides resources to whichever player maintains control of it.

QINGHAI_LAKE_SHRINE.Name: QINGHAI_LAKE_SHRINE
QINGHAI_LAKE_SHRINE.NAME: Qinghai Shrine
QINGHAI_LAKE_SHRINE.LR: A mysterious shrine that generates Favor for whomever captures and controls it.

TEMPLE_CHINESE_SPC.Name: TEMPLE_CHINESE_SPC
TEMPLE_CHINESE_SPC.NAME: Temple
TEMPLE_CHINESE_SPC.LR: Generates unlimited wealth for whomever captures and controls it.

PILLAR_CHINESE.Name: PILLAR_CHINESE
PILLAR_CHINESE.NAME: Celestial Pillar
PILLAR_CHINESE.SR: This pillar holds up the sky, separating heaven and earth.

BROKEN_PILLAR_CHINESE.Name: BROKEN_PILLAR_CHINESE
BROKEN_PILLAR_CHINESE.NAME: Broken Celestial Pillar
BROKEN_PILLAR_CHINESE.SR: This pillar has been damaged and is in need of repair.

GREAT_WALL.Name: GREAT_WALL
GREAT_WALL.NAME: Great Wall
GREAT_WALL.LR: Protects towns. Shift-click to place wall sections, and then click to place the wall.

GREAT_WALL_GATE.Name: GREAT_WALL_GATE
GREAT_WALL_GATE.NAME: Great Wall Gate
GREAT_WALL_GATE.LR: A gate in the mighty Great Wall of China.

WATERMILL.Name: WATERMILL
WATERMILL.NAME: Watermill
WATERMILL.LR: A drop site where Commoners deposit Food and Wood that they have gathered.

MINING_CAMP_JAPANESE.Name: MINING_CAMP_JAPANESE
MINING_CAMP_JAPANESE.NAME: Mining Camp
MINING_CAMP_JAPANESE.LR: A drop site where Commoners deposit Gold that they have gathered.

SHRINE_JAPANESE.Name: SHRINE_JAPANESE
SHRINE_JAPANESE.NAME: Shrine
SHRINE_JAPANESE.SR: Generates Favor when tended by a Miko.
SHRINE_JAPANESE.LR: Generates Favor when tended by a Miko. Boosted by nearby natural resources, and upgrades Mikos.

SHRINE_OF_THE_HUNT.Name: SHRINE_OF_THE_HUNT
SHRINE_OF_THE_HUNT.NAME: Shrine of the Hunt
SHRINE_OF_THE_HUNT.SR: Food drop site. An enchanted shrine that spawns deer and wolves.
SHRINE_OF_THE_HUNT.LR: Food drop site. A Shrine enchanted by Minakatatomi to periodically spawn huntable deer as well as friendly defensive wolves.

GUARDHOUSE.Name: GUARDHOUSE
GUARDHOUSE.NAME: Guardhouse
GUARDHOUSE.LR: Japanese Guardhouses train and upgrade infantry units and ranged soldiers.

DOJO.Name: DOJO
DOJO.NAME: Dojo
DOJO.SR: Military building. Trains elite Japanese warriors.
DOJO.LR: Japanese Dojos train and upgrade elite Japanese warriors.

STABLE_JAPANESE.Name: STABLE_JAPANESE
STABLE_JAPANESE.NAME: Stable
STABLE_JAPANESE.LR: Japanese Stables train and upgrade cavalry units.

CASTLE.Name: CASTLE
CASTLE.NAME: Castle
CASTLE.SR: Fortification. Trains siege engines and heroes.
CASTLE.LR: Japanese Castles fire arrows and garrison units. They also train siege engines and heroes.

GOSHINBOKU.Name: GOSHINBOKU
GOSHINBOKU.NAME: Goshinboku
GOSHINBOKU.LR: Respawns the most recently fallen myth units for whomever captures and controls it.

SACRED_GATE.Name: SACRED_GATE
SACRED_GATE.NAME: Sacred Gate
SACRED_GATE.SR: Reduces the cost of reinvoking God Powers.
SACRED_GATE.LR: Reduces the cost of reinvoking God Powers for whomever captures and controls it.

TORII_GATE.Name: TORII_GATE
TORII_GATE.NAME: Torii Gate
TORII_GATE.LR: Heals units friendly to whomever controls it.

CALPULLI.Name: CALPULLI
CALPULLI.NAME: Calpulli
CALPULLI.LR: A drop site where Villagers deposit Food, Wood, or Gold they have gathered.

CALPULLI_LIVESTOCK_PEN.Name: CALPULLI_LIVESTOCK_PEN
CALPULLI_LIVESTOCK_PEN.NAME: Calpulli (Livestock Pen)
CALPULLI_LIVESTOCK_PEN.LR: A drop site where Villagers deposit Food, Wood, or Gold they have gathered. Food dropped off is increased, and may spawn a livestock animal after depositing a number of resources.

CALPULLI_LUMBER_OUTPOST.Name: CALPULLI_LUMBER_OUTPOST
CALPULLI_LUMBER_OUTPOST.NAME: Calpulli (Lumber Outpost)
CALPULLI_LUMBER_OUTPOST.LR: A drop site where Villagers deposit Food, Wood, or Gold they have gathered. Wood dropped off is increased, and has a defensive tower with garrison space.

CALPULLI_CRAFT_WORKSHOP.Name: CALPULLI_CRAFT_WORKSHOP
CALPULLI_CRAFT_WORKSHOP.NAME: Calpulli (Craft Workshop)
CALPULLI_CRAFT_WORKSHOP.LR: A drop site where Villagers deposit Food, Wood, or Gold they have gathered. Gold dropped off is increased, and a small portion of wood and food dropped off here is converted to gold.

WAR_HUT.Name: WAR_HUT
WAR_HUT.NAME: War Hut
WAR_HUT.LR: Aztec War Huts train and upgrade infantry and counter-infantry units.

NOBLES_HUT.Name: NOBLES_HUT
NOBLES_HUT.NAME: Noble's Hut
NOBLES_HUT.LR: Aztec Noble Huts train and upgrade powerful elite units.

GREAT_TEMPLE.Name: GREAT_TEMPLE
GREAT_TEMPLE.NAME: Great Temple
GREAT_TEMPLE.LR: Aztec Great Temples fire arrows and garrison units. They also train and upgrade elite units.

SMOKE_TRAP.Name: SMOKE_TRAP
SMOKE_TRAP.NAME: Smoke Trap
SMOKE_TRAP.LR: Smoke Traps, when triggered, greatly reduce enemy visibility of affected units in the area. Max 6 traps.

SPIKE_TRAP.Name: SPIKE_TRAP
SPIKE_TRAP.NAME: Spike Trap
SPIKE_TRAP.LR: Spike Traps, when triggered, greatly damage nearby enemies. Max 6 traps.

OBSIDIAN_SHARD.Name: OBSIDIAN_SHARD
OBSIDIAN_SHARD.NAME: Obsidian Shard
OBSIDIAN_SHARD.LR: Spawns a random Aztec myth unit of your current age when expiring.

JAGUAR_MOON_TEMPLE.Name: JAGUAR_MOON_TEMPLE
JAGUAR_MOON_TEMPLE.NAME: Temple of the Jaguar Moon
JAGUAR_MOON_TEMPLE.SR: Capturable temple. Provides resources to whichever player maintains control of it.
JAGUAR_MOON_TEMPLE.LR: Capturable temple. Provides bonuses when captured.

INFESTED_DEN.Name: INFESTED_DEN
INFESTED_DEN.NAME: Infested Nest
INFESTED_DEN.SR: Spawns scorpions that obey your commands.
INFESTED_DEN.LR: Infested Nest which spawns scorpions that obey your commands.

AGAVE_BLOOM.Name: AGAVE_BLOOM
AGAVE_BLOOM.NAME: Agave Bloom
AGAVE_BLOOM.SR: Food Source. Heals nearby targets or provides food.
AGAVE_BLOOM.LR: Villagers tasked on a the Agave Bloom will gather Food rapidly. This magical plant will contain more Food if it is invoked in later ages, and heal nearby units rapidly, at the cost of its power.

MONOLITH_OF_TLALOC.Name: MONOLITH_OF_TLALOC
MONOLITH_OF_TLALOC.NAME: Pillar of Tlálocan
MONOLITH_OF_TLALOC.LR: Pillar of Tlálocan. Invokes water attacks if enemies are nearby.

OBSIDIAN_OBELISK.Name: OBSIDIAN_OBELISK
OBSIDIAN_OBELISK.SR: Portal from Mictlan that spawns undead.
